claim_scope: The Python and Rust GlobalSettlementABI V1 SHADOW cores implement bounded subject-bound perps margin deposit, Oracle-bound position-carrying withdrawal, Oracle-free flat-account withdrawal, and terminal close as deterministic candidate transitions with exact typed no-op rejection and cross-language accepted-transition root vectors. The state requires exact peer-to-peer zero net position, at most 64 accounts, explicit ACTIVE/DRAIN_ONLY/HALTED lifecycle, and namespaced terminal obligations. Subject authentication and grant authority remain composition obligations.
failure_modes: a position-carrying withdrawal reaches candidate effects without a complete Oracle authority, occurrence, and price binding
a mismatched Oracle price is used for a withdrawal maintenance decision
a deposit or close silently accepts irrelevant Oracle authority and expands the receipt's degrees of freedom
floor rounding or a strict comparison permits one atom below the maintenance requirement
candidate effects omit or mis-sign the account, perps accounting-location, or claimant-liability delta
a rejected command changes state, consumes an occurrence, or carries an economic effect
a drained account ID reopens after terminal closure
release retirement disables withdrawals and strands a claimant's collateral
a flat-account claimant cannot withdraw during an Oracle outage even though price cannot affect maintenance
an unbalanced peer-to-peer position state creates unexplained net market exposure
an unbounded account vector exceeds the reviewed proof and resource envelope or a 65th-account deposit escapes typed no-op rejection
two releases or markets reuse one terminal-obligation identifier for the same local account ID
hash-derived terminal obligations retain account order and violate canonical obligation-ID order
the leaf journal hides its command or Oracle dependency behind a zero or substitutable private-port root
Rust and Python serialize the same transition into different roots

aaa.reason: Focused examples arrange exact immutable context, state, and command values, act through one functional transition, and assert the complete accepted candidate or typed no-op rejection. Exhaustive, parameterized, and parity tests retain their independent-oracle shape.

reject_is_noop.reason: Policy and boundary rejection tests assert the exact reject code, identical pre/post state root, and an empty effect plan. Malformed typed context is rejected before transition evaluation.

mutations.description: replace ceiling maintenance division with floor division or reverse the exact threshold comparison
allow withdrawal when the Oracle authority triple is absent
accept a complete Oracle binding whose price differs from the committed market index price
accept surplus Oracle authority on deposit or close
omit or reverse one candidate account, accounting-location, or claimant-liability delta
mutate a rejected transition's state root or attach an economic effect
permit a terminally closed account identifier to reopen
treat release retirement as a boolean disable that also blocks claimant withdrawal and close
require Oracle availability to drain collateral from a flat account
accept an unbalanced peer-to-peer market position vector
remove the bounded 64-account proof envelope, use a non-strict 65-account comparison, or leak an untyped construction failure from a 65th-account deposit
derive terminal-obligation IDs from only a local account ID
retain account order after hashing terminal-obligation IDs instead of sorting by the committed ID
remove or reorder an Oracle context field in one canonical Rust or Python receipt projection
substitute the typed private port or full-input statement while retaining the original accepted journal

nonclaims: The module emits route-incomplete candidate effects and has no global conservation row, lane coordinator, route composer, proof guest, verifier, mount, writer, or publication authority.
The committed Oracle fields are caller data until a governed route verifies an opaque GlobalOracleOccurrenceAuthorityV1 witness and pairs the price with an authenticated Oracle module output.
The accepted-transition golden vectors do not constitute a shared data-driven Rust/Python rejection-parity corpus.
Funding, intent matching, position opening, liquidation, insurance, ADL, bankruptcy, migration, and whole-market terminal closeout remain outside this slice.
The M6 PERPS_MARKET capability remains REQUIRED_UNRESOLVED, production_authority remains NONE, and this evidence does not establish production readiness or safety of all value movement.
